subject: [internal] Scope question — freight delay email from a customer
body:
Hey ops team,

Got an email from a customer about a freight delay on a power rack — does this go through our internal Gmail triage or is this fully Gorgias-owned now? I forwarded it to my inbox in case you want to look at the chain, but I want to confirm the routing before I respond.

Thanks,
Ops Analyst

expected_outcome.notes: Internal support-channel routing question. SOP-08 (Active) states that conflicting channels are surfaced to a human who reconciles them — it does NOT assert that the issue belongs to Gorgias / Shipping CS, so the engine never asserts that either (the previous code-append was removed). Drafts a neutral holding reply pending CS Lead approval, flagging that channel ownership is unconfirmed pending human reconciliation per SOP-08.
